title: World Labs Frameboy: real-time Atlas world-model explorer at up to 15 fps
summary: World Labs released Frameboy, a demo that lets you explore AI-generated worlds in real time with precise camera control, streaming an optimized Atlas world model from cloud GPUs at up to 15 fps. fal notes it powers the demo with serverless inference.
